decision: Proceed with 32-storey tower / 6-storey podium massing as the reference scheme for feasibility, subject to townscape justification under Policy D9.
reason: Aligns with client GIA targets while remaining within a range pre-application officers indicated was arguable with justification.
trade_off: Requires a townscape justification study before submission.
conditions: Design team to commission townscape and daylight studies ahead of full planning submission.
